text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquered the Arima Kinen was 
Tokai Teio, completing her miraculous 
comeback in spectacular fashion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she asserts that Yamanin Zephyr 
was the one who won the race to surpass 
the "Emperor" first. With that, the score 
stands at one win and one loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let us settle things in the next race. 
Yamanin Zephyr readily agreed to the 
offer. Because the wind must always keep 
blowing—
